Empires & Puzzles Fortuna Review: Masked Goddess of Fate Strategy Guide

Fortuna arrived with a mask and a massive nerf stick, but her priority dispel remains one of the rarest skills in Empires & Puzzles. Is she still a Goddess of Fate or just a niche support? We analyze her fiends, her stats, and why she might be the tactical solution your roster needs.

Fortuna's design is striking, embodying the mysterious elegance of the Masquerade. She wears an ornate golden mask and blue robes, surrounded by floating, disembodied masks that serve as her weapons/minions. The art perfectly captures the "Carnival of Gods" aesthetic—beautiful, slightly unsettling, and undeniably regal. It’s a sophisticated look that stands out even among the flashy modern designs.

If you pulled Fortuna, celebrate! You have a "Swiss Army Knife" for difficult raid stages. Even at 3/70, her dispel is valuable. Pair her with your strongest sniper; she opens the door, and the sniper walks through it. Prioritize her survivability above all else.
Fortuna is a luxury tool. You likely have higher stat heroes, but do you have a

? Probably not many. She is worth keeping for War depth, especially against Ludwig tanks or heavy counterattack teams. Do not waste Alpha Aethers on her unless you use her daily; LB1 is usually sufficient for her support role.
The release of Fortuna was... dramatic.
“Sounds like Ice is the new Dark... way to ‘nerf’ Ludwig.”
— Early optimism turned to salt when the nerf hammer hit.
“Dispels, damages, and forces fiends down your throat? At a fast speed? Sheesh…”
— A beta tester's reaction before the nerf.
The community consensus shifted from "She is broken OP" in Beta to
"She’s pretty much a Hannah with a dispel"
"A rare hero like Fortuna and her defining special is dispel? How dispellapointing."
Despite the complaints about her damage, experienced players recognized her value:
"She is great on offense, that fast dispel is crazy handy... I treat the damage as a bonus."

Fortuna is the ultimate "utility over vanity" hero. She won't win you any "highest damage hit" screenshots, and her stat card looks like a relic from a bygone era. But when you are staring down a team protected by Taunt, Dodge, and Defense Up, Fortuna is the skeleton key that unlocks victory.
She strips the enemy naked, hands them a cursed mask, and lets your
hitters do the work. Just don't ask her to arm wrestle any of the new Construct heroes; she'll lose.
A timeless utility support who aged gracefully in skill, if not in stats.
